_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: This is a Toggle
A simple boolean, aka True or False set the initial value with "default"
This is a Choice
Let the user pick from a list of values
allow_custom_value let a player define their own text value
Currently the only use for Choice in Manual outside of hooks is the goal
This is a Range
Allow the player to specify a value between 'start' and 'end'
if you include a "values" you can define the label for certain values
Currently the only use for Range in Manual outside of hooks is 'filler_trap'

filter_mode_trap_enabled.description: Include Filter Mode Trap in the trap item pool.

boss_keys_required_for_boss_table_open.description: How many Boss Keys are required to open the Boss Table.

task_shuffle_enabled.description: Shuffle Task objectives between Task checks of the same difficulty. Score and Boss checks stay fixed.

score_adjustment_mode.description: Overlay-only score display multiplier for score checks. Easy shows half scores, Normal shows baseline scores, Hard shows 1.5x scores, and Maddening shows 2x scores.

random_start_tables_open.description: Use the player file's generated five-table random Ball 1 start instead of a fixed opening spread.

base_game_seed_type.description: Standard keeps the normal six checks per table. Deep Run builds 20 checks per selected table: 10 score checks and 10 table-specific task checks.

base_game_feature_unlock_enabled.description: Lock feature-heavy tables behind Feature Keys. Deep Run enables this automatically.

base_game_active_table_count.description: How many tables from the larger Base Game pool should exist in this seed's active graph. A 15-table Deep Run uses three starter tables, then four one-lock tables, four two-lock tables, two three-lock tables, and two four-lock tables. Higher counts continue the one/two/three/four-lock pattern.

base_game_selection_mode.description: How the active Base Game world groups should be assembled from the catalog. Random chooses five-world packs at random. Curated reads the curated world-group list. Hybrid uses the curated list first and random-fills the rest.

description: Comma-separated world group keys, labels, table codes, or table names in the episode order you want them to appear.
Used when Base Game Selection Mode is Curated or Hybrid.
Examples: storm_chasers, steve_ritchie_showcase, dennis_nordman_party_monsters.
Comma-separated table names or table codes to use when Base Game Selection Mode is Curated Table List.
The selected tables are de-duplicated, shuffled into five-table worlds, and given generated world names and color banners.
Example: Medieval Madness, Attack from Mars, Theatre of Magic, Monster Bash, Star Trek: The Next Generation.
Named table chunks to use when Base Game Selection Mode is Curated Table List.
Each line can be formatted as World Name: Table A | Table B | Table C | Table D | Table E.
When set, custom world sets preserve your grouping and world names instead of shuffling the curated table list into generated worlds.
Optional per-world curator bylines for named or curated Base Game worlds.
Use one line per world slot in world order. Blank or missing lines fall back to the player name.

base_game_random_one_featured_designer_o.description: When enabled, random Base Game world selection will include at most one Featured Designer world. Fully curated selections are left alone, but hybrid random fill also respects the cap.

base_game_starting_open_table_count.description: How many of the active Base Game tables should be flagged as the initial open set in the seed-time payload.

base_game_enabled.description: Emit Base Game active-table-set payloads in slot_data for clients and overlays.
